items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Ministry of Health, Order in Council 1271/2024
items.verbatim_snippet: Following a Ministry-appointed investigation into the hospital’s governance, management and quality of care, the Lieutenant Governor in Council appointed Eric Hanna as Supervisor under subsection 9(1) of the Public Hospitals Act.

items.date_raw: revoked at the end of June 8, 2025
items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Ministry of Health, Order in Council 767/2025
items.verbatim_snippet: His appointment took effect on September 26, 2024 and was revoked at the end of June 8, 2025, when he stepped down and was succeeded by Carmine Stumpo.

items.date_raw: June 9, 2025, with the Order approved June 5, 2025
items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Ministry of Health, Order in Council 767/2025
items.verbatim_snippet: After Eric Hanna indicated that he wished to step down, the Lieutenant Governor in Council appointed Carmine Stumpo to continue the Supervisor’s duties.
